observations: Black folding-style electric bike with large fat tires, photographed on a tiled outdoor floor against a grey wall.
Two black battery packs mounted on the main frame tube, visible in photo 0.
Rear cargo rack with a wood-grain patterned plate bolted on, visible in photo 0.
Front end (photo 1) shows a small windscreen/number-plate holder with a faint logo/graphic that is too blurred to read clearly, flanked by extended handlebar mirrors.
Mud and dust visible on the front fork, wheel rim and lower frame in both photos.
No speedometer/display screen, charge port, serial plate, or battery percentage indicator is visible or legible in either photo.

Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / SAINTULOT ENT' overlays both images, not part of the item.

risks.if_unproven: priced as degraded/unknown-capacity battery, worst case near replacement cost

risks.risk: Motor and overall drivetrain may not function (no power-on evidence).

risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically and mechanically compromised

risks.risk: No visible odometer/mileage or usage history.
risks.proof: Photo of the dashboard/display showing total distance or hours used.

proof_requests: Short video of the bike powering on, display lighting up, and being ridden a short distance.
Close-up, well-lit photo of both battery labels showing voltage/Ah and any serial numbers.
Close-up of the front badge/logo area in photo 1 to confirm brand/model.
Photos of frame joints, fork, and brakes in clear light to assess rust/damage.
Any receipt or document proving ownership and purchase date.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a folding electric bike by type, but none of the seller's functional or grading claims are shown or provable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-verified-working e-bike with unknown battery health pending the listed proofs.
